body:
Proves positive recurrence for every fixed real λ > 0 for the exact permanent-seed deterministic-first-chunk CTMC, with invisible empty first-choice waiting rooms and immediate departure on completion. A single global Foster function gives the all-state drift bound; localization and finite-mean regeneration establish the result in the original continuous-time clock.

Adds a six-page research note, source, bibliographic metadata and a portable verification archive in [publication/](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/tree/acc269a3ecf5b009e164b49ecfd3b89d4f4e956e/unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30001608/publication). The 40 original research files are preserved byte-for-byte.

Validation: clean extraction reproduces the historical and independent exact controls, including deliberate mathematical and wrapper failures. Two new sequential independent AI reviews checked the entire paper and package without finding a substantive objection. The second reviewer rebuilt all six pages and matched their rendered contents. The universal theorem is proved analytically; finite tests and the labelled simulation are supplementary. [Audit and review records](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/tree/6ca3ab074f4f2879ba387d69b6ef5adf9df21248/final_full_solution_sweep_20261020_01a15be7/audits/pr0292_30001608).

The contribution is the all-load extension of the 2010/checked-2011-author-proof conjecture. The elementary small-load argument and classical methods are credited. Priority review is bounded, with the uninspected final 2011/2015 editions disclosed; no worldwide-firstness or continuing-openness certificate is claimed. AI tools were used extensively. This is an unrefereed preprint, without formal independent human peer review. Published as [DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23524971](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23524971). The public PDF and verification ZIP match the reviewed bytes; the DOI resolves and the publication is recorded once in the tracker (Math Puzzles, row 174).
title: Prove all-load stability for deterministic-first-chunk problem 30001608
